title: Dealer Program Guide: Kestrel New Vehicle Retail Underwriting Limits by Tier
content:
**Kestrel New Vehicle Retail Installment Sale Contract, dealer program grid.** The limits below bound what each credit tier of the Kestrel New Vehicle Retail Installment Sale Contract may book. The term and the amount financed must lie between the tier's minimum and maximum (both ends permitted); the advance may not exceed the tier's maximum loan-to-value percentage of the vehicle value basis (MSRP for a new vehicle); the scheduled payment may not exceed the tier's maximum payment-to-income percentage of verified gross monthly income; and a cash or trade-equity down payment of at least the tier's minimum percentage of the selling price is required.

| Tier | Term (months) | Amount financed (USD) | Max loan-to-value | Max payment-to-income | Min down payment |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| Kestrel New Vehicle Retail Tier 5 | 24 to 60 | 7,500.00 to 42,000.00 | 105 percent | 12 percent | 15 percent |
| Kestrel New Vehicle Retail Tier 4 | 24 to 72 | 7,500.00 to 52,000.00 | 110 percent | 14 percent | 10 percent |
| Kestrel New Vehicle Retail Tier 3 | 24 to 72 | 5,000.00 to 65,000.00 | 115 percent | 15 percent | 5 percent |
| Kestrel New Vehicle Retail Tier 2 | 24 to 84 | 5,000.00 to 80,000.00 | 120 percent | 17 percent | 0 percent |
| Kestrel New Vehicle Retail Tier 1 | 24 to 84 | 5,000.00 to 95,000.00 | 125 percent | 18 percent | 0 percent |
| Kestrel New Vehicle Retail Tier 1+ | 24 to 84 | 5,000.00 to 110,000.00 | 130 percent | 20 percent | 0 percent |

Figures in plain form for each column, Tier 5 through Tier 1+: shortest term 24 months on every tier; longest term 60, 72, 72, 84, 84 and 84 months; smallest amount financed 7500, 7500, 5000, 5000, 5000 and 5000 dollars; largest amount financed 42000, 52000, 65000, 80000, 95000 and 110000 dollars.

## Points of judgement

- A tier with a 0 percent minimum down payment requires no down payment; a tier with a positive minimum requires at least that share of the selling price, and a down payment of exactly that share meets it.
- The limits are each tier's own; an application that meets one tier's limits but sits in another tier's score band is held to the limits of the tier its score places it in.

*Hypothetical illustration:* a Tier 4 application for 73 months exceeds that tier's 72-month maximum and cannot be booked on Tier 4; a Tier 3 application at a 115 percent advance sits exactly at that tier's maximum and is within it.
